title: AI Evaluation Framework
summary: This module offers a comprehensive framework for evaluating AI models and agents, encompassing dataset generation, diverse evaluator implementations, and online evaluation with robust reporting features.

nodes.label: Evaluation Core
nodes.title: Evaluation Core Components
nodes.description: Provides foundational components for defining, generating, and executing evaluation datasets. It includes data models for datasets, utilities for asynchronous task execution, and logic for AI-driven dataset generation.

nodes.label: Evaluator Implementations
nodes.title: Evaluator Implementations
nodes.description: Offers a variety of evaluator types, ranging from base classes for individual case assessment to specialized evaluators for comprehensive report analysis. Includes LLM-based judging and statistical evaluators.

nodes.label: Online Evaluation & Reporting
nodes.title: Online Evaluation & Reporting
nodes.description: Provides tools for online evaluation of AI agent runs and function calls, dispatching evaluators asynchronously, and reporting results to various sinks including OpenTelemetry. Includes metric rendering utilities.

edges.label: references evaluators
edges.title: Dataset Evaluator References
edges.description: Evaluation datasets defined in the core module can specify which evaluators from the implementations module should be used for assessment.

edges.label: uses evaluators from
edges.title: Online Evaluator Dispatch
edges.description: The online evaluation system dispatches and runs evaluators provided by the implementations module to assess agent outputs in real-time.

edges.label: leverages core logic
edges.title: Runtime Logic Dependency
edges.description: Online evaluation relies on the core module's utilities for task execution, dataset structures, and asynchronous operations to manage evaluation runs.

groups.label: Data & Generation
groups.title: Evaluation Data & Generation
groups.description: Focuses on defining the structure of evaluation datasets and generating synthetic test cases, often leveraging AI models for automated data creation.

groups.label: Evaluator Library
groups.title: Evaluator Implementations
groups.description: Contains a diverse set of evaluators for assessing AI outputs, from simple content checks to complex statistical analyses and LLM-based judgments.

groups.label: Runtime & Reporting
groups.title: Online Evaluation & Reporting
groups.description: Manages the execution of evaluations in real-time, dispatches evaluators, and handles the reporting of results to various observability and storage systems.
